scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-korea in the 1800 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1800.geojson; file SHA256 51fcb6b1f1c361956a3fc24a9c646844ff88754842aa113780428fb4abcd5f2c; geometry SHA256 5fde5c7b4ffc2668ee0bc844daec99d7d819fc2fb0bc44e1db39ddb68c01f317; map IDs entity-korea
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 225258.70392343905 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
